name: Skull
summary: Bluffing push-your-luck game where players stack rose and skull discs and bet how many they can reveal.
rules_text: Each player has 3 roses and 1 skull as a hidden hand and a mat. Rounds: each player in turn must place one card face-down on their own stack if able. At any time on your turn instead of placing you may announce a bet: number of cards you claim you can flip showing only roses. Betting then goes around: raise or pass. Once all but one pass, the challenger resolves: first flip all their own placed cards, then flip others' top cards in any order, one by one. If they reveal exactly their bet in roses with no skull, they win the round and mark their mat; two marks wins the game. If they reveal a skull, they lose: the owner of that skull chooses one card at random from challenger's hand to discard permanently. A player with no cards left is eliminated. Last player standing also wins.
